name: heartopia-mp-paint
description: Browser multiplayer pixel painting game using Heartopia's palette and canvas sizes

scripts.assets: npm run card && npm run icons && npm run badges
scripts.check:seo: node tools/check_seo.mjs && node tools/check_social_card.mjs && node tools/check_readme_numbers.mjs && node tools/check_readme_links.mjs

comments.ws: Only needed for the optional relay server and its tests. The website itself has no build step and no dependencies.
comments.run: node server/relay.js must be run from the repo root - it imports the shared canvas model from assets/js/.
comments.playwright: dev-only, and not used by `npm test`. It backs the throwaway layout/behaviour probes in _research/, which drive a real browser because some bugs are only measurable in one. `npx playwright install chromium` once.
comments.port: tools/serve.cjs reads the PORT env var, default 8080. On this machine 8080 is already taken by an unrelated app that answers on both localhost and 127.0.0.1 - use PORT=8099.
